# TPC-Havoc Q6_v8

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
select
    sum(l_extendedprice * l_discount) as revenue
from
    lineitem l1
where
    l1.l_shipdate >= date '1994-01-01'
    and l1.l_shipdate < date '1994-01-01' + interval '1' year
    and l1.l_discount between 0.06 - 0.01 and 0.06 + 0.01
    and l1.l_quantity < 24
    and exists (
        select 1
        from lineitem l2
        where l2.l_orderkey = l1.l_orderkey
          and l2.l_linenumber = l1.l_linenumber
    )
```
